backend/main.mo: Main actor implementing a media sharing platform with video/photo upload, comments, likes, channels, user profiles, and role-based access control using mixins for storage and authorization.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that transforms old actor state (videos and photos without engagement features) to new state with likeCount, commentCount, comments, videoLikes, channels, and userProfiles.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five implemented features: video download button, like functionality, comment system, custom channel names, and video quality selector with associated files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, hooks, and configuration for the media sharing application with video/photo galleries, upload functionality, and user profiles.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives defining OKLCH color system variables for light and dark modes with custom design tokens for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, and chart colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the MediaShare application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for home, galleries, upload pages, media viewers, and settings, all wrapped in Layout component.
frontend/src/components/AuthButton.tsx: Authentication button component integrating Internet Identity with sign in/out functionality and dropdown menu displaying truncated principal when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/ChannelNameDispl: Component displaying user channel names with loading skeleton, fetching channel name via hook and showing truncated principal if no custom name is set.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays a comment section for videos with a form to add new comments (authenticated users only) and a list of existing comments with author names and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with sticky header navigation (home, videos, photos), upload dropdown menu, settings button, authentication button, and footer with social links.
frontend/src/components/PhotoCard.tsx: Card component displaying a photo thumbnail with title, uploader channel name, and upload date; navigates to photo detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without a profile to enter their name (required) and optional channel name (3-30 characters) on first login.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: Card component displaying a video thumbnail with title, uploader channel name, upload date, like count, and comment count; navigates to video detail page on click.
frontend/src/components/VideoQualitySele: Dropdown menu component for selecting video quality (auto, 360p, 480p, 720p, 1080p) with a note about browser and source limitations.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAddComment.ts: Mutation hook for adding comments to videos that invalidates related queries on success and shows toast notifications for success/error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useChannelName.ts: Query hook that fetches the channel name for a given principal, falling back to the principal string if unavailable, with 5-minute cache.
frontend/src/hooks/useComments.ts: Query hook that fetches all comments for a specific video ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useGetCallerUserProfi: Query hook that fetches the current authenticated user's profile, properly handling actor initialization state and returning null if no profile exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhoto.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single photo by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotos.ts: React Query hook that fetches all photo metadata and their full data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePhotoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook for uploading photos with progress tracking, converting files to ExternalBlob and invalidating photo queries on success.
frontend/src/hooks/useSaveCallerUserProf: React Query mutation hook for saving user profile data with toast notifications and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useSetChannelName.ts: React Query mutation hook for setting channel names with validation (3-30 characters) and toast notifications.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideo.ts: React Query hook that fetches a single video by ID from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoLike.ts: React Query mutation hook for liking videos with error handling for unauthorized and duplicate likes.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideos.ts: React Query hook that fetches all video metadata and their full data from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoUpload.ts: React Query mutation hook for uploading videos with progress tracking, converting files to ExternalBlob and invalidating video queries on success.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors, including sidebar, chart, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page component with hero section, gradient background banner, and cards linking to video/photo browsing and upload pages.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoGallery.tsx: Photo gallery page that displays a grid of photos using PhotoCard components with loading and empty states.
frontend/src/pages/PhotoViewer.tsx: Displays a single photo with its metadata (title, description, uploader, upload date) in a detailed view with navigation back to the photo gallery.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides a settings page for authenticated users to update their profile name and channel name, with form validation and loading states.
frontend/src/pages/UploadPhoto.tsx: Handles photo upload functionality with a form for title, description, and file selection, showing upload progress and success/error states.
frontend/src/pages/UploadVideo.tsx: Manages video upload with a form for title, description, and file selection, displaying upload progress and success confirmation.
frontend/src/pages/VideoGallery.tsx: Displays a grid of video cards from the community, with loading and error states, and an empty state for when no videos exist.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPlayer.tsx: Renders a video player page with video metadata, like/download functionality, quality selection, and a comment section for authenticated users.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support and functions to clear sensitive parameters from URLs.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, container settings, border radius variables, custom animations (accordion), and font family defaults with typography and container query plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting a YouTube-like video and photo sharing platform with user authentication, separate galleries for photos/videos, upload functionality, and a known issue where uploaded content doesn't display in galleries.
